name: The Contract Folder Test: answer key

terms_settled_from_text.about: The date questions are worked out from CUAD's date and renewal labels. For these six contracts the contract's own text departs from CUAD's renewal labels, and the term is taken from the text.

contracts.from_the_text: s.16.1: after the 3-year initial term it continues for an indefinite period until terminated, not renewal terms
s.2.1: renews once, for twelve months, and then expires
s.8.1: in effect until either party ends it on 30 days' notice, no renewal
s.2.1: fifteen contract years, then until either party ends it on 30 days' notice
a form of agreement "dated as of [●]", filed in 2020
s.3: thirty years from a 2014 effective date, then year to year on 60 days' notice
